TWINGATE_NETWORK.prompt: Name of the Twingate network (the part before .twingate.com)

TWINGATE_ACCESS_TOKEN.prompt: Access token of the connector, from the Twingate admin console

TWINGATE_REFRESH_TOKEN.prompt: Refresh token of the connector, from the Twingate admin console

description.en_US: The Twingate Connector is a network component deployed behind firewalls to facilitate Zero Trust Network Access. It acts as a bridge to provide secure access to private resources without requiring changes to network architecture.

tips: An Access Token and a Refresh Token generated via the Twingate Admin Console or API are required to run the Connector
